articles.title: India 10-year bond gives up post-policy gains as oil moves, RBI swap pullback weigh
articles.description: Indian government bonds saw a decline for the second consecutive day, erasing previous gains as high oil prices and the premature conclusion of a deposit scheme weighed on investor sentiment. Following the central bank's policy announcement, the benchmark bond yield rose sharply. Swap rates also jumped, indicating a negative shift in market mood. Future bond yields will be influenced by both global and local factors.

articles.title: Euro zone bonds join global selloff, long-end yields at multi-year highs
articles.description: On Tuesday, yields on longer-dated euro zone bonds surged to levels not seen in years. The increasing oil prices, spurred by diminishing expectations for a quick resolution to the conflict in Iran, intensified inflation worries throughout the markets. Consequently, investors are anticipating a quarter-point interest rate hike from the ECB, while apprehensions about fiscal stability in various nations add pressure on global bonds.

articles.title: Who is ‘Raja D King’? Amritsar resident distributes petrol worth ₹1000 for free
articles.description: Amritsar-based Rakesh Trehan, also known as 'Raja Ji the King,' is introducing a unique community initiative called 'Petrol Langar' in Chandigarh, offering free petrol to people at select fuel stations. This concept extends the traditional langar beyond food, with fuel coupons of ₹500 for two/three-wheelers and ₹1000 for four-wheelers being distributed. Eligibility is as simple as saying 'Jai Mata Di.' Trehan, a crypto trader who reportedly uses Bitcoin profits for charity, has previously organized 'paison ka langar' distributing cash and food, and plans an 'iPhone langar' in the future. The 'Petrol Langar' is scheduled to begin on August 18th at Sidhu Petrol Pump and HP Pump, with coupons distributed beforehand at Oberoi Motors.
